Cap Cana vs Casa de Campo for a luxury golf vacation: which is better?

\n

It depends on the golf you want. Casa de Campo in La Romana has three Pete Dye courses, including Teeth of the Dog, and its own small airport (LRM). Cap Cana, about 20 minutes from Punta Cana International Airport, has Punta Espada, ranked #1 in the Caribbean and Mexico by GolfWeek, and the open back nine at Las Iguanas. For a group that wants to stay on the course, Villa Espada sits on Fairway 5 of Punta Espada with the member-guest discounted rate included; Teeth of the Dog is about 90 minutes away as a day trip.

faq_add.q: Cap Cana vs Casa de Campo for a luxury golf vacation: which is better?
faq_add.a: It depends on the golf you want. Casa de Campo in La Romana has three Pete Dye courses, including Teeth of the Dog, and its own small airport (LRM). Cap Cana, about 20 minutes from Punta Cana International Airport, has Punta Espada, ranked #1 in the Caribbean and Mexico by GolfWeek, and the open back nine at Las Iguanas. For a group that wants to stay on the course, Villa Espada sits on Fairway 5 of Punta Espada with the member-guest discounted rate included; Teeth of the Dog is about 90 minutes away as a day trip.
